limitations: Only one homogeneous one-state finite CTMC and one parameter are tested.
Six separate scalar backward calls are measured; this is not one network-loss backward timing.
Logical tensor bytes exclude Python, allocator, serialized metadata and the retained autograd graph. RSS includes the whole fresh process.
All quantities are evaluated at delay multiples with fixed event timing; no gradients through delay, logical time or changing boundary geometry are assessed.
The scalar conversion warning is retained in each original stderr; no rerun was made to remove it.
Source and saved outputs were independently read; no second numerical execution was made.
reference_review: For exponential active lifetime with rate lambda and deterministic refractory d, kth emission is Gamma(k,lambda)+(k-1)d. The expected emission count is the finite sum of its CDF; refractory mass is EN(T)-EN(T-d), active mass is one minus refractory. Differentiate each gamma CDF to obtain s*exp(-lambda*s)*(lambda*s)^(k-1)/(k-1)!. Signed channel uses exact binary FP64 -0.3. This independently matches the diagnostic index and output ordering.
storage_review: For these integer-multiple horizons only one pending packet remains. Its generator order is m=2*T/d, alpha has 2*m entries, output m, reset 1, and other state tensors have 13 entries. The logical FP64 payload is 8*(m*m+3*m+14) bytes. This is a property of this implemented representation and example, not a lower bound on every equivalent model.
